title: Local lossless library
tagline: Eight ways in, indexed entirely on your phone
description: Organise your collection across eight views. Search finds music instantly, and audio stays on your phone.
overview: Your music library stays on your phone. Bitperfect Player indexes local storage and SD cards, reading tags and artwork straight from the files. Search returns instant results without a network connection.

benefits.title: Eight browsing views
benefits.desc: Browse across Sources, Recent, Favourites, Playlists, Albums, Artists, Tracks, Genres.

benefits.title: Instant search
benefits.desc: Search your collection by title, artist or album. Search runs on your phone.

benefits.title: Accurate tags and artwork
benefits.desc: Reads tags and artwork straight from the file, even if the file extension is wrong.

benefits.title: On-device privacy
benefits.desc: Your music, library, history and favourites stay on your phone, with no tracking.

lede: Works with internal storage, MicroSD, USB drives and network shares. Tags and artwork come from the file itself.

beats.title: Eight ways to browse your music
beats.body: Sources, Recent, Favourites, Playlists, Albums, Artists, Tracks, Genres. Sources shows your real folders, the way you organised them.

beats.title: Search never leaves the phone
beats.body: Your library is indexed on the phone. Search by title, artist or album, with instant results. Missing covers download only when you ask.

beats.title: Less common formats, played natively
beats.body: Plays the common formats, from FLAC and WAV to MP3 and AAC. Also the rarer ones: Monkey's Audio, WavPack, TAK, True Audio, Musepack and DSD disc images.

beats.title: It reads the playlists you already have
beats.body: Import M3U, M3U8, PLS, XSPF, ASX and CUE playlists. It works even if the file extension is missing or wrong. Export any playlist as M3U or M3U8.
beats.note: Import six formats. Export two: M3U and M3U8.

cta.title: Select your music folder. Indexing runs entirely on your phone.
